svg.aria-label: Technology stack of E-CFunds in five layers: frontend (React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, React Router, React Query, PWA, jsPDF, Excel, Lucide), mobile (Capacitor, Android, Capgo updater, push and local notifications), backend on Supabase (PostgreSQL, Row Level Security, Auth, Storage, Realtime, Edge Functions, pg_cron, pg_net), external services (Firebase Cloud Messaging, Web Push, Google Gemini, Gmail SMTP, Google OAuth), and hosting and DevOps (Vercel, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Docker with nginx, Docker Hub).
svg.text: same code wrapped as an app
builds, tests and ships every change
Versions as used in E-CFunds, November 2026. All services run on their free tiers.
